'''Mining Facility 81-B''' was a [[mining]] facility in the [[Spice mines of Kessel|spice mines]] of the [[planet]] [[Kessel]]. [[Commander]] [[Ellian Zahra]] was in charge of the facility when she received a [[hologram]] transmission from [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], who assigned her to hunt down the [[division]]s of the scattered [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]].<ref name="SW 8" />
